I am old now, 82 years, and my plot is very small — just a little piece for beans mixed with other things. I have no money for fertilizer from the shop, and one bag is too much for my tiny garden anyway. I use the seeds I kept from last harvest like my mother taught me, and I put a little manure from the goats near the house when I can. My grandchildren help me weed because my back is not strong, and I cannot pay anyone.
